trend_summary: AI adoption is accelerating across knowledge work while robotics continues to displace routine physical and administrative tasks. The WEF Future of Jobs 2025 projects 39% of core skills will transform by 2030, with strong growth in analytical thinking, systems thinking, and AI literacy.

Critical Thinking.reason: Strongly future-proof. AI increases the value of evaluating outputs.

Complex Problem Solving.reason: High demand as AI creates more complex challenges.

Data Entry.reason: Highly automatable by RPA and AI agents.

future_career_pathways: Transition from routine admin into AI coordination roles
general_guidance: Prioritize skills with multipliers above 1.20. Suggest upskilling in Critical Thinking and Systems Thinking.
